title: पाषाण युग का प्यार: 20,000 साल पहले इंसान रिश्ते कैसे बनाते थे?
tts_style: Read this aloud as an energetic, upbeat, enthusiastic young male reel narrator in natural conversational Hindi, with crisp, sharp articulation and high clarity:
style_look: Modern 2D cartoon stickman explainer style: oversized round white heads with tiny expressive black eyes, simple white bodies and thin black stick-like limbs, clean slightly hand-drawn black outlines, minimal facial features and expressive body language. Colourful flat 2D cartoon scenery with soft shading and subtle shadows, visually rich but uncluttered backgrounds, balanced warm colour palette, consistent character proportions and design.
